_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Royal University's Library#001.src: There's a note on the wagon...

The Royal University's Library#002.src: On the note, there's a {~}x{~} grid with some numbers. It seems to represent the flowerbed somehow.
The Royal University's Library#002.dst: 쪽지에는 숫자가 적힌 {~}x{~} 격자가 그려져 있다. 아무래도 화단을 나타내는 것 같다.

The Royal University's Library#003.src: Would you like to try making heads or tails of this?

The Royal University's Library#004.src: The groundskeeper just stormed off in a huff... He seemed stressed about something.
The Royal University's Library#004.dst: 정원 관리인이 방금 씩씩대면서 가 버렸어... 뭔가 때문에 스트레스받은 것 같던데.
The Royal University's Library#004.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#005.src: I guess I would be too if I had to make a flower display for the Queen's visit, but he has a design to go off of, so it couldn't be too hard, right?
The Royal University's Library#005.dst: 여왕 폐하가 오실 때 맞춰 꽃 장식을 해야 한다면 나라도 그렇겠지만, 따라 할 도안이 있으니까 그렇게 어렵진 않을 거 아냐?
The Royal University's Library#005.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#006.src: Oh... right... The chancellor had that one puzzle-obsessed girl make the garden plan... Now it all makes sense...
The Royal University's Library#006.dst: 아... 맞다... 총장님이 그 퍼즐에 푹 빠진 여자애한테 정원 설계를 맡겼지... 이제야 다 이해가 가네...
The Royal University's Library#006.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#008.src: No pass, no entry. Buzz off.
The Royal University's Library#008.dst: 출입증 없으면 못 들어가. 썩 꺼져.
The Royal University's Library#008.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#009.src: ...Wha? Surely ya couldn't be around 'ere without knowin' about this place...
The Royal University's Library#009.dst: ...뭐여? 이 근방에 있으면서 여길 모를 리가 없잖여...
The Royal University's Library#009.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#010.src: This is The Royal University of Aelumia, the finest educational institution in the province. I'd be baffled if ya hadn't heard of it.
The Royal University's Library#010.dst: 여긴 {c2}Aelumia 왕립 대학{/}, 이 지방 최고의 교육 기관이라고. 이걸 못 들어 봤다면 기가 막힐 노릇이지.
The Royal University's Library#010.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#011.src: Anyway. It's my duty to make sure the students 'ere are safe. And that job involves turnin' away people like you. Be gone.
The Royal University's Library#011.dst: 어쨌든. 여기 학생들 안전을 지키는 게 내 일이여. 너 같은 놈들 쫓아내는 것도 그 일에 들어가고. 꺼져.
The Royal University's Library#011.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#012.src: Time to see how he's getting on...
The Royal University's Library#012.dst: 그 친구 일이 어떻게 돼 가나 볼까...
The Royal University's Library#012.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#014.src: It's perfect!! Thank you so much!! Wait...
The Royal University's Library#014.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#015.src: You're not the groundskeeper... What's going on here?
The Royal University's Library#015.dst: 너 정원 관리인이 아니잖아... 이게 어떻게 된 거야?
The Royal University's Library#015.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#016.src: ...You planted the flowerbed yourself? Normally, I'd punish students for interfering in official business, but you did such a good job, you're off the hook!
The Royal University's Library#016.dst: ...네가 직접 화단을 심었다고? 원래 공무에 끼어든 학생은 벌을 주는데, 이렇게 잘했으니 봐줄게!
The Royal University's Library#016.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#017.src: You'd ought to go and take a rest after all that hard work! What about... the library?
The Royal University's Library#017.dst: 그렇게 열심히 일했으니 가서 좀 쉬어야지! 어디 보자... {c2}도서관{/}은 어때?
The Royal University's Library#017.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#018.src: ...You don't have a pass? Oh, silly you, you must've forgotten it. Here, let me write you a permission slip so you don't have to go searching for it right now.
The Royal University's Library#018.dst: ...출입증이 없다고? 아이참, 깜빡했나 보구나. 자, 지금 당장 찾으러 다니지 않아도 되게 허가증을 써 줄게.
The Royal University's Library#018.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#019.src: Uh, boss, I don't think they're a...
The Royal University's Library#019.speaker: Guard

The Royal University's Library#020.src: Shhh... Guards are to be seen and not heard.
The Royal University's Library#020.dst: 쉿... 경비는 눈에만 띄고 입은 다무는 거야.
The Royal University's Library#020.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#021.src: There. Here you go. Oh, and one more thing:
The Royal University's Library#021.dst: 자, 됐다. 받아. 아, 그리고 하나 더:
The Royal University's Library#021.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#022.src: Please wear a school uniform when Her Majesty comes around, alright?
The Royal University's Library#022.dst: 여왕 폐하께서 오실 때는 꼭 교복 입어야 해, 알았지?
The Royal University's Library#022.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#023.src: You can now access the University's library.
The Royal University's Library#023.dst: 이제 대학 도서관을 이용할 수 있다.

The Royal University's Library#024.src: A signed permission slip from the Chancellor? Huh. Alright.
The Royal University's Library#024.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#025.src: Come with me. I have to escort you.
The Royal University's Library#025.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#026.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} KA to {~} KA

The Royal University's Library#027.src: Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} KA to {~} KA
The Royal University's Library#027.note: {c1}Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} KA to {~} KA{/}

The Royal University's Library#028.src: General of the Wings Division from {~} KA to {~} KA
The Royal University's Library#028.note: {c1}General of the Wings Division from {~} KA to {~} KA{/}

The Royal University's Library#029.src: Ranger of the {p} from {~} KA to {~} KA
The Royal University's Library#029.note: {c1}Ranger of the {p} from {~} KA to {~} KA{/}

The Royal University's Library#031.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} KA to {~} NA
The Royal University's Library#031.note: {c1}Sovereign of the {p} from {~} KA to {~} NA{/}

The Royal University's Library#035.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} KA to present
The Royal University's Library#035.note: {c1}Sovereign of the {p} from {~} KA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#036.src: Ranger of the {p} from {~} KA to present
The Royal University's Library#036.note: {c1}Ranger of the {p} from {~} KA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#038.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} NA to {~} IA
The Royal University's Library#038.note: {c1}Sovereign of the {p} from {~} NA to {~} IA{/}

The Royal University's Library#039.src: Sovereign of the Penitence District from {~} KA to present
The Royal University's Library#039.note: {c1}Sovereign of the Penitence District from {~} KA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#040.src: Warden of the Deraj Imperial Prison from {~} NA to present
The Royal University's Library#040.note: {c1}Warden of the Deraj Imperial Prison from {~} NA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#045.src: Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} KA to {~} NA
The Royal University's Library#045.note: {c1}Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} KA to {~} NA{/}

The Royal University's Library#046.src: General of the Wings Division from {~} KA to {~} NA
The Royal University's Library#046.note: {c1}General of the Wings Division from {~} KA to {~} NA{/}

The Royal University's Library#048.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} NA to present
The Royal University's Library#048.note: {c1}Sovereign of the {p} from {~} NA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#049.src: Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} NA to present
The Royal University's Library#049.note: {c1}Marshal of the Provincial Guard from {~} NA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#050.src: General of the Wings Division from {~} NA to present
The Royal University's Library#050.note: {c1}General of the Wings Division from {~} NA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#052.src: Sovereign of the {p} from {~} IA to present
The Royal University's Library#052.note: {c1}Sovereign of the {p} from {~} IA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#056.src: Special Sovereign of the Queen from {~} IA to present
The Royal University's Library#056.note: {c1}Special Sovereign of the Queen from {~} IA to present{/}

The Royal University's Library#057.src: This book is called "About The Structure of Her Majesty's Provincial Guard". It seems to detail the province's military structure.
The Royal University's Library#057.dst: {c2}"여왕 폐하의 지역 경비대 구조에 관하여"{/}라는 책이다. 이 지방의 군사 구조를 자세히 다룬 것 같다.
The Royal University's Library#057.note: {c2}"About The Structure of Her Majesty's Provincial Guard"{/}

The Royal University's Library#058.src: It's split up into different sections... Which would you like to read first?
The Royal University's Library#058.dst: 여러 장으로 나뉘어 있다... 어느 것부터 읽어 볼까?

The Royal University's Library#059.src: ...That's the end of that section. Read another?
The Royal University's Library#059.dst: ...이 장은 여기서 끝이다. 다른 장도 읽어 볼까?

The Royal University's Library#060.src: Within all divisions, there are four ranks that a soldier can hope to attain.
The Royal University's Library#060.dst: {c1}모든 부대에는 병사가 오를 수 있는 네 가지 계급이 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#060.note: {c1}Within all divisions, there are four ranks that a soldier can hope to attain.{/}

The Royal University's Library#061.src: The lowest rank is Guardsman, a role bestowed upon all recruits who have passed training.
The Royal University's Library#061.dst: {c1}가장 낮은 계급은 경비병으로, 훈련을 통과한 모든 신병에게 주어진다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#061.note: {c1}The lowest rank is Guardsman, a role bestowed upon all recruits who have passed training.{/}

The Royal University's Library#062.src: Guardsmen are the basic footsoldiers of our Military, and, despite their low status, are among the most honorable people of our Province.
The Royal University's Library#062.dst: {c1}경비병은 우리 군의 기본 보병이며, 지위는 낮지만 우리 지방에서 가장 명예로운 이들에 속한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#062.note: {c1}Guardsmen are the basic footsoldiers of our Military, and, despite their low status, are among the most honorable people of our Province.{/}

The Royal University's Library#063.src: Above Guardsmen are the Captains, who lead small squadrons of them, as well as outposts.
The Royal University's Library#063.dst: {c1}경비병 위에는 대장이 있으며, 경비병 소대와 전초 기지를 이끈다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#063.note: {c1}Above Guardsmen are the Captains, who lead small squadrons of them, as well as outposts.{/}

The Royal University's Library#064.src: Captains are selected from the Guardsmen who are deemed best at team leadership or combat, and can be distinguished from their subordinates by their golden epaulettes.
The Royal University's Library#064.dst: {c1}대장은 경비병 중 지휘나 전투에 가장 뛰어나다고 인정받은 자들 가운데서 뽑히며, 금색 견장으로 부하들과 구별된다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#064.note: {c1}Captains are selected from the Guardsmen who are deemed best at team leadership or combat, and can be distinguished from their subordinates by their golden epaulettes.{/}

The Royal University's Library#065.src: Higher still on the ladder are the Commanders, chosen from the best among the Captains.
The Royal University's Library#065.dst: {c1}그보다 더 높은 자리에는 대장 중 최고의 인재들로 뽑힌 사령관이 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#065.note: {c1}Higher still on the ladder are the Commanders, chosen from the best among the Captains.{/}

The Royal University's Library#066.src: Commanders are significantly more powerful than Captains, often leading entire fortresses of soldiers, and giving orders to the Captains assigned to them.
The Royal University's Library#066.dst: {c1}사령관은 대장보다 훨씬 강한 권한을 지니며, 흔히 요새 하나의 병력 전체를 이끌고 휘하의 대장들에게 명령을 내린다.{/}

The Royal University's Library#067.src: Finally, each division is led by a single General. The Generals are the best of the best in their divisions, and report directly to their respective Sovereign, as well as the Sovereign bearing the role of Marshal - Majin as of writing..
The Royal University's Library#067.dst: {c1}마지막으로, 각 부대는 단 한 명의 장군이 이끈다. 장군은 부대 내 최정예 중의 최정예로, 각자의 군주와 원수 직을 맡은 군주(집필 시점에는 Majin)에게 직접 보고한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#067.note: {c1}Finally, each division is led by a single General. The Generals are the best of the best in their divisions, and report directly to their respective Sovereign, as well as the Sovereign bearing the role of Marshal - Majin as of writing..{/}

The Royal University's Library#068.src: Every region of Fruma has its own different needs, and thus, each has its own division of the Guard.
The Royal University's Library#068.dst: {c1}Fruma의 각 지역은 필요한 것이 저마다 다르기에, 지역마다 고유한 경비대 부대가 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#068.note: {c1}Every region of Fruma has its own different needs, and thus, each has its own division of the Guard.{/}

The Royal University's Library#069.src: In {p}, The {p}, The {p}, and {p}, the main job of a guardsman is to keep citizens safe from insurgents and criminals.
The Royal University's Library#069.dst: {c1}{p}, {p}, {p}, 그리고 {p}에서 경비병의 주된 임무는 반란분자와 범죄자로부터 시민을 지키는 것이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#069.note: {c1}In {p}, The {p}, The {p}, and {p}, the main job of a guardsman is to keep citizens safe from insurgents and criminals.{/}

The Royal University's Library#070.src: Guards are recruited from able and willing civilians of these regions, so they understand well the wants of those they defend, and the need to keep them safe.
The Royal University's Library#070.dst: {c1}경비병은 이 지역들의 유능하고 의욕 있는 민간인 중에서 모집되기에, 자신이 지키는 이들의 바람과 그들을 안전하게 지켜야 할 필요성을 잘 이해한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#070.note: {c1}Guards are recruited from able and willing civilians of these regions, so they understand well the wants of those they defend, and the need to keep them safe.{/}

The Royal University's Library#071.src: In the {p} and Penitence District, however, their job is to keep the region secure and make sure that civilians do not go wandering into them. Penitence District guards also bear the additional responsibility of keeping prisoners in line.
The Royal University's Library#071.dst: {c1}그러나 {p} 지역과 Penitence District에서는 지역의 안전을 지키고 민간인이 그 안으로 헤매어 들어가지 않게 하는 것이 그들의 임무다. Penitence District 경비병은 죄수들을 통제하는 책임도 추가로 진다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#071.note: {c1}In the {p} and Penitence District, however, their job is to keep the region secure and make sure that civilians do not go wandering into them. Penitence District guards also bear the additional responsibility of keeping prisoners in line.{/}

The Royal University's Library#072.src: Guards for those particular divisions are recruited from those who enlisted for other regions, who are assessed as capable of a higher duty.
The Royal University's Library#072.dst: {c1}이 특수 부대의 경비병은 다른 지역에 지원해 입대한 자들 중, 더 높은 임무를 감당할 수 있다고 평가된 이들로 뽑는다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#072.note: {c1}Guards for those particular divisions are recruited from those who enlisted for other regions, who are assessed as capable of a higher duty.{/}

The Royal University's Library#073.src: Perhaps the most noble division of all is the Xima division, a subdivision of the Auburn Guard.
The Royal University's Library#073.dst: {c1}아마 모든 부대 중 가장 고귀한 것은 Auburn 경비대의 하위 부대인 Xima 부대일 것이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#073.note: {c1}Perhaps the most noble division of all is the Xima division, a subdivision of the Auburn Guard.{/}

The Royal University's Library#074.src: The best among the {p}'s guardsmen are recruited for this role, to defend the province's borders and keep it safe from the dangers outside.
The Royal University's Library#074.dst: {c1}{p}의 경비병 중 최고의 인재들이 이 역할에 선발되어, 지방의 국경을 지키고 외부의 위험으로부터 지방을 보호한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#074.note: {c1}The best among the {p}'s guardsmen are recruited for this role, to defend the province's borders and keep it safe from the dangers outside.{/}

The Royal University's Library#075.src: Each region has its own divisional colour to differentiate its soldiers from those of other regions, for instance, Auburn guards wear red, and the {p}'s guards wear blue.
The Royal University's Library#075.dst: {c1}각 지역에는 자기 병사를 다른 지역 병사와 구별하기 위한 고유의 부대 색이 있다. 예를 들어 Auburn 경비병은 빨간색을, {p}의 경비병은 파란색을 입는다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#075.note: {c1}Each region has its own divisional colour to differentiate its soldiers from those of other regions, for instance, Auburn guards wear red, and the {p}'s guards wear blue.{/}

The Royal University's Library#076.src: The Constabulary are a unique division of the Guard, clearly distinct from the regional divisions thanks to their heavy armor. They serve as extra muscle when just the regional guard is not enough, and all regions will usually be assigned a handful.
The Royal University's Library#076.dst: {c1}치안대는 경비대의 독특한 부대로, 중장갑 덕분에 지역 부대와 확연히 구별된다. 지역 부대만으로 부족할 때 추가 병력 역할을 하며, 대개 모든 지역에 몇 명씩 배치된다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#076.note: {c1}The Constabulary are a unique division of the Guard, clearly distinct from the regional divisions thanks to their heavy armor. They serve as extra muscle when just the regional guard is not enough, and all regions will usually be assigned a handful.{/}

The Royal University's Library#077.src: Regional Commanders must collaborate with the leadership of the Constabulary to handle this delegation of manpower. Said leadership is, despite all of the division's differences, structurally identical to that of the other regions.
The Royal University's Library#077.dst: {c1}지역 사령관은 이러한 인력 배분을 처리하기 위해 치안대 지휘부와 협력해야 한다. 이 지휘부는 부대의 여러 차이에도 불구하고 구조상 다른 지역의 지휘부와 똑같다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#077.note: {c1}Regional Commanders must collaborate with the leadership of the Constabulary to handle this delegation of manpower. Said leadership is, despite all of the division's differences, structurally identical to that of the other regions.{/}

The Royal University's Library#078.src: Constables are typically selected from regional soldiers who surpass their peers, but not sufficiently so to become a Captain. To get onto the Constabulary is viewed as a proud achievement by members of the military.
The Royal University's Library#078.dst: {c1}치안대원은 보통 동료보다 뛰어나지만 대장이 될 정도는 아닌 지역 병사 중에서 뽑힌다. 치안대에 들어가는 것은 군인들 사이에서 자랑스러운 성취로 여겨진다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#078.note: {c1}Constables are typically selected from regional soldiers who surpass their peers, but not sufficiently so to become a Captain. To get onto the Constabulary is viewed as a proud achievement by members of the military.{/}

The Royal University's Library#079.src: Each Constable has authority equivalent to what would be {~} rank above them in a regular division. For example, a Constable Guardsman has authority over an Auburn Guardsman in any situation.
The Royal University's Library#079.dst: {c1}모든 치안대원은 일반 부대에서 자기보다 {~}계급 위에 해당하는 권한을 지닌다. 예를 들어 치안대 경비병은 어떤 상황에서든 Auburn 경비병보다 권한이 높다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#079.note: {c1}Each Constable has authority equivalent to what would be {~} rank above them in a regular division. For example, a Constable Guardsman has authority over an Auburn Guardsman in any situation.{/}

The Royal University's Library#080.src: This rule, however, does not apply to the top of the ladder - the General of the Constabulary is equal in authority to their fellow Generals.
The Royal University's Library#080.dst: {c1}단, 이 규칙은 최상위에는 적용되지 않는다. 치안대 장군은 다른 장군들과 동등한 권한을 지닌다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#080.note: {c1}This rule, however, does not apply to the top of the ladder - the General of the Constabulary is equal in authority to their fellow Generals.{/}

The Royal University's Library#081.src: Constables tend to wear Aelumia purple when not assigned to a region, but, if they are assigned, must wear the region's colours instead, so as to indicate their current task.
The Royal University's Library#081.dst: {c1}치안대원은 지역에 배치되지 않았을 때는 대개 Aelumia의 보라색을 입지만, 배치되면 현재 임무를 나타내기 위해 그 지역의 색을 입어야 한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#081.note: {c1}Constables tend to wear Aelumia purple when not assigned to a region, but, if they are assigned, must wear the region's colours instead, so as to indicate their current task.{/}

The Royal University's Library#082.src: Some citizens find Constables intimidating due to their masks making them unrelatable, but they should rest assured that the Constables are only there to defend them.
The Royal University's Library#082.dst: {c1}일부 시민은 가면 때문에 친근감이 없는 치안대원을 위협적으로 느끼지만, 치안대원은 오직 시민을 지키기 위해 있으니 안심해도 된다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#082.note: {c1}Some citizens find Constables intimidating due to their masks making them unrelatable, but they should rest assured that the Constables are only there to defend them.{/}

The Royal University's Library#083.src: The Wings are the highest division in the Guard, with all of its members having mastered combat, and the use of Her Majesty's blessings therein.
The Royal University's Library#083.dst: {c1}날개 기사단은 경비대 최고의 부대로, 모든 단원이 전투와 그 속에서 여왕 폐하의 축복을 쓰는 법에 통달했다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#083.note: {c1}The Wings are the highest division in the Guard, with all of its members having mastered combat, and the use of Her Majesty's blessings therein.{/}

The Royal University's Library#084.src: This division's troops are recruited from two sources, one being soldiers who have demonstrated great skill above their peers, and the other being new recruits who are identified as combat prodigies during training.
The Royal University's Library#084.dst: {c1}이 부대의 병력은 두 경로로 모집된다. 하나는 동료보다 월등한 기량을 보인 병사이고, 다른 하나는 훈련 중 전투의 천재로 인정받은 신병이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#084.note: {c1}This division's troops are recruited from two sources, one being soldiers who have demonstrated great skill above their peers, and the other being new recruits who are identified as combat prodigies during training.{/}

The Royal University's Library#085.src: Wings are immediately given a blessing upon attaining the rank (given that they do not already possess one), and are iconic across all of Fruma for their distinct gilt-platinum armor.
The Royal University's Library#085.dst: {c1}날개 기사단원은 그 계급에 오르는 즉시 (아직 축복이 없다면) 축복을 받으며, 독특한 금도금 백금 갑옷으로 Fruma 전역에서 상징적인 존재다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#085.note: {c1}Wings are immediately given a blessing upon attaining the rank (given that they do not already possess one), and are iconic across all of Fruma for their distinct gilt-platinum armor.{/}

The Royal University's Library#086.src: They are generally purely ceremonial, but are also deployed in places of high importance, for maximum safety. In cases of severe emergency, Wings will be called upon to provide assistance, giving rise to the saying, "If there's Wings, take flight!"
The Royal University's Library#086.dst: {c1}이들은 대체로 순전히 의례적인 존재지만, 최대한의 안전을 위해 매우 중요한 장소에도 배치된다. 심각한 비상시에는 날개 기사단이 지원에 나서는데, 여기서 "날개가 보이면 날아서 도망쳐라!"라는 말이 생겼다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#086.note: {c1}They are generally purely ceremonial, but are also deployed in places of high importance, for maximum safety. In cases of severe emergency, Wings will be called upon to provide assistance, giving rise to the saying, "If there's Wings, take flight!"{/}

The Royal University's Library#087.src: In {p}, Wings are constantly present in order to protect the seat of the Fruman government, and to reflect this important role, they are known instead as the Gendarmerie.
The Royal University's Library#087.dst: {c1}{p}에는 Fruma 정부의 본거지를 지키기 위해 날개 기사단이 상시 배치되어 있으며, 이 중요한 역할을 반영해 이들은 헌병대라 불린다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#087.note: {c1}In {p}, Wings are constantly present in order to protect the seat of the Fruman government, and to reflect this important role, they are known instead as the Gendarmerie.{/}

The Royal University's Library#088.src: Gendarmes are led by a single powerful Commander within Aelumia citadel; one of the greatest of all Wings, and their titanium armor is painted black to indicate their specialization to this role within the division.
The Royal University's Library#088.dst: {c1}헌병은 Aelumia 성채 안에서 강력한 사령관 한 명이 이끈다. 그는 날개 기사단 전체에서도 손꼽히는 인물이며, 헌병의 티타늄 갑옷은 부대 내 이 역할에 특화되었음을 나타내기 위해 검게 칠해져 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#088.note: {c1}Gendarmes are led by a single powerful Commander within Aelumia citadel; one of the greatest of all Wings, and their titanium armor is painted black to indicate their specialization to this role within the division.{/}

The Royal University's Library#089.src: The General of the Wings division generally also holds the position of Marshal of the Guard. All Wings soldiers additionally have authority over those in other divisions who are of equal or subordinate ranks to them.
The Royal University's Library#089.dst: {c1}날개 기사단 장군은 대개 경비대 원수 직도 겸한다. 또한 모든 날개 기사단 병사는 다른 부대에서 자신과 같거나 낮은 계급인 자들에 대해 권한을 가진다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#089.note: {c1}The General of the Wings division generally also holds the position of Marshal of the Guard. All Wings soldiers additionally have authority over those in other divisions who are of equal or subordinate ranks to them.{/}

The Royal University's Library#090.src: This book is titled "History of the {p}"

The Royal University's Library#091.src: Would you like to read it?

The Royal University's Library#092.src: The {p} are a treacherous region, and all kinds of terrible beasts take residence within their dense fog. Despite this, after the Queen liberated our Province, some made efforts to settle them.
The Royal University's Library#092.dst: {c1}{p}은(는) 위험한 지역으로, 짙은 안개 속에 온갖 무시무시한 짐승이 살고 있다. 그럼에도 여왕께서 우리 지방을 해방하신 뒤, 일부는 그곳에 정착하려 애썼다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#092.note: {c1}The {p} are a treacherous region, and all kinds of terrible beasts take residence within their dense fog. Despite this, after the Queen liberated our Province, some made efforts to settle them.{/}

The Royal University's Library#093.src: For around four hundred years, these efforts were somewhat effective, and were bolstered by the introduction of a Sovereign in {~} KA - Caetal, of the Owl Clan - who could use his blessing to guide his people through the dense fog.
The Royal University's Library#093.dst: {c1}약 400년 동안 이러한 노력은 어느 정도 효과가 있었고, KA {~}년 군주가 임명되며 더욱 힘을 얻었다. 바로 올빼미 씨족의 Caetal로, 그는 축복을 써서 짙은 안개 속에서 백성을 이끌 수 있었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#093.note: {c1}For around four hundred years, these efforts were somewhat effective, and were bolstered by the introduction of a Sovereign in {~} KA - Caetal, of the Owl Clan - who could use his blessing to guide his people through the dense fog.{/}

The Royal University's Library#094.src: Despite all this, many resources had to be sunk into sustaining the region, and citizens frequently lost their lives to the creatures within. In {~} KA, it was decided that the region was too dangerous to inhabit.
The Royal University's Library#094.dst: {c1}그럼에도 지역을 유지하는 데 막대한 자원이 들어갔고, 시민들은 그 안의 생물에게 자주 목숨을 잃었다. KA {~}년, 이 지역은 사람이 살기에 너무 위험하다고 결정되었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#094.note: {c1}Despite all this, many resources had to be sunk into sustaining the region, and citizens frequently lost their lives to the creatures within. In {~} KA, it was decided that the region was too dangerous to inhabit.{/}

The Royal University's Library#095.src: Her Majesty decreed that year that The {p} were to no longer be open to the public, for their own safety, and began efforts to help migrate the region's people to other areas of Fruma.
The Royal University's Library#095.dst: {c1}그해 여왕 폐하께서는 시민의 안전을 위해 {p}을(를) 더 이상 일반에 개방하지 않는다는 칙령을 내리시고, 지역 주민을 Fruma의 다른 지역으로 이주시키는 일을 돕기 시작하셨다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#095.note: {c1}Her Majesty decreed that year that The {p} were to no longer be open to the public, for their own safety, and began efforts to help migrate the region's people to other areas of Fruma.{/}

The Royal University's Library#096.src: In this decree, she established a new role - Ranger of the {p} - tasked to manage military affairs within the region and help rescue any citizens who may venture in and get lost.
The Royal University's Library#096.dst: {c1}이 칙령에서 폐하께서는 새로운 직책인 {p}의 레인저를 신설하셨으며, 그 임무는 지역 내 군사 업무를 관리하고 들어갔다가 길을 잃은 시민의 구조를 돕는 것이었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#096.note: {c1}In this decree, she established a new role - Ranger of the {p} - tasked to manage military affairs within the region and help rescue any citizens who may venture in and get lost.{/}

The Royal University's Library#097.src: Sovereign Caetal did not have any interest in this role, and stepped down, so Sovereign Gitephe of the {p} assumed the role until a new Sovereign could be appointed for the task.
The Royal University's Library#097.dst: {c1}Caetal 군주는 이 직책에 관심이 없어 물러났고, 이에 {p}의 Gitephe 군주가 이 임무를 맡을 새 군주가 임명될 때까지 그 직을 맡았다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#097.note: {c1}Sovereign Caetal did not have any interest in this role, and stepped down, so Sovereign Gitephe of the {p} assumed the role until a new Sovereign could be appointed for the task.{/}

The Royal University's Library#098.src: The {p} Division of the Provincial Guard was reorganized to suit this new role, their new tasks including defence of the region's borders, and escorting supply wagons traveling between the then-Agricultural District and the {p}.
The Royal University's Library#098.dst: {c1}지역 경비대의 {p} 부대는 이 새 역할에 맞게 재편되었으며, 새 임무에는 지역 경계 방어와, 당시 농업 지구였던 곳과 {p} 사이를 오가는 보급 수레 호위가 포함되었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#098.note: {c1}The {p} Division of the Provincial Guard was reorganized to suit this new role, their new tasks including defence of the region's borders, and escorting supply wagons traveling between the then-Agricultural District and the {p}.{/}

The Royal University's Library#099.src: In {~} KA, a new Sovereign was appointed to manage the {p}, this being Sovereign Gikyo, who, as of writing, holds the office to this day. Sovereign Gitephe transferred his role of Ranger onto them.
The Royal University's Library#099.dst: {c1}KA {~}년, {p}을(를) 관리할 새 군주가 임명되었으니, 바로 집필 시점까지도 그 직을 맡고 있는 Gikyo 군주다. Gitephe 군주는 레인저 직을 Gikyo에게 넘겼다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#099.note: {c1}In {~} KA, a new Sovereign was appointed to manage the {p}, this being Sovereign Gikyo, who, as of writing, holds the office to this day. Sovereign Gitephe transferred his role of Ranger onto them.{/}

The Royal University's Library#100.src: Sovereign Gikyo has done an excellent job of managing the region and keeping it stable, and so nothing more of note has happened in the region since then.
The Royal University's Library#100.dst: {c1}Gikyo 군주는 지역을 훌륭히 관리하며 안정을 유지해 왔고, 그 이후로 이 지역에서는 특별히 언급할 만한 일이 일어나지 않았다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#100.note: {c1}Sovereign Gikyo has done an excellent job of managing the region and keeping it stable, and so nothing more of note has happened in the region since then.{/}

The Royal University's Library#101.src: Some citizens claim that people still live in the {p} based on supposed sightings of humans in the area, but this is false.
The Royal University's Library#101.dst: {c1}일부 시민은 그 일대에서 사람을 봤다는 목격담을 근거로 아직도 {p}에 사람이 산다고 주장하지만, 이는 사실이 아니다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#101.note: {c1}Some citizens claim that people still live in the {p} based on supposed sightings of humans in the area, but this is false.{/}

The Royal University's Library#102.src: It has been suggested, however, that Cursed Ones may be hiding from the Crown in the forest's fog, so if you see such a thing, do not ever approach, for your life could be at risk.
The Royal University's Library#102.dst: {c1}다만, 저주받은 자들이 숲의 안개 속에 숨어 왕실을 피하고 있을 가능성이 제기되었으니, 그런 것을 보더라도 절대 다가가지 마라. 목숨이 위험할 수 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#102.note: {c1}It has been suggested, however, that Cursed Ones may be hiding from the Crown in the forest's fog, so if you see such a thing, do not ever approach, for your life could be at risk.{/}

The Royal University's Library#103.src: If you make contact with such an individual, contact the appropriate authorities as soon as you can.
The Royal University's Library#103.dst: {c1}그런 자와 접촉했다면 가능한 한 빨리 관계 당국에 신고하라.{/}
The Royal University's Library#103.note: {c1}If you make contact with such an individual, contact the appropriate authorities as soon as you can.{/}

The Royal University's Library#104.src: This book is called "Professor Pestal's Ultimate Guide to Fruma's Fauna". As the name would suggest, it seems to contain information on all of the creatures in the province.
The Royal University's Library#104.dst: 제목은 {c2}"Pestal 교수의 Fruma 동물상 완벽 가이드"{/}다. 이름처럼 이 지방의 모든 생물에 관한 정보가 담겨 있는 것 같다.
The Royal University's Library#104.note: {c2}"Professor Pestal's Ultimate Guide to Fruma's Fauna"{/}

The Royal University's Library#105.src: ...It would take you hours to read through completely. But, maybe you could read a few pages. The interesting ones.
The Royal University's Library#105.dst: ...전부 읽으려면 몇 시간은 걸리겠다. 하지만 몇 페이지 정도는 읽어도 될 것 같다. 흥미로운 부분만.

The Royal University's Library#106.src: Unfortunately, you don't have access to the Blossom Wing, so you'll not be seeing those drawings.
The Royal University's Library#106.dst: 안타깝게도 꽃 학부 건물에는 들어갈 수 없으니, 그 그림들은 볼 수 없다.

The Royal University's Library#107.src: ...Anyway, That's the end of that passage. Read another?
The Royal University's Library#107.dst: ...아무튼, 이 단락은 여기서 끝이다. 다른 것도 읽어 볼까?

The Royal University's Library#108.src: Unfortunately, not all creatures last forever. Many are extinct, and one sad example is the Adasaur, which once populated the gorgeous hills of the {p}.
The Royal University's Library#108.dst: {c1}안타깝게도 모든 생물이 영원히 살아남는 것은 아니다. 많은 종이 멸종했으며, 그 슬픈 예가 한때 {p}의 아름다운 언덕에 서식하던 Adasaur다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#108.note: {c1}Unfortunately, not all creatures last forever. Many are extinct, and one sad example is the Adasaur, which once populated the gorgeous hills of the {p}.{/}

The Royal University's Library#109.src: The Adasaur, a relative of the {p}' Kivaraptor, was highly adapted to its home in the {p}, possessing remarkable leg strength with which it could climb hills effortlessly and jump meters into the air.
The Royal University's Library#109.dst: {c1}{p}의 Kivaraptor와 가까운 친척인 Adasaur는 서식지인 {p}에 고도로 적응해, 언덕을 힘들이지 않고 오르고 몇 미터나 뛰어오를 수 있는 놀라운 다리 힘을 지녔다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#109.note: {c1}The Adasaur, a relative of the {p}' Kivaraptor, was highly adapted to its home in the {p}, possessing remarkable leg strength with which it could climb hills effortlessly and jump meters into the air.{/}

The Royal University's Library#110.src: It used these strengths very well, and was a formidable predator, known to slay Woolly Rhinos with ease. It also slew humans with ease.
The Royal University's Library#110.dst: {c1}Adasaur는 이 강점을 아주 잘 활용한 무시무시한 포식자로, 털코뿔소를 손쉽게 사냥하는 것으로 알려졌다. 인간도 손쉽게 사냥했다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#110.note: {c1}It used these strengths very well, and was a formidable predator, known to slay Woolly Rhinos with ease. It also slew humans with ease.{/} , humans は斜体

The Royal University's Library#111.src: In a sad but necessary act for the safety of the Fruman people, the Adasaurs were wiped out during the New Age, and have not graced our lands since.
The Royal University's Library#111.dst: {c1}Fruma 사람들의 안전을 위한 슬프지만 필요한 조치로, Adasaur는 새 시대에 몰살되었고 그 뒤로 우리 땅에 모습을 보이지 않았다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#111.note: {c1}In a sad but necessary act for the safety of the Fruman people, the Adasaurs were wiped out during the New Age, and have not graced our lands since.{/}

The Royal University's Library#112.src: The University possesses a skeleton of the Adasaur, allowing us some idea of their scale. We also possess drawings of them from before their extinction.
The Royal University's Library#112.dst: {c1}본교는 Adasaur의 골격을 소장하고 있어 그 크기를 어느 정도 가늠할 수 있다. 멸종 전에 그린 그림도 소장하고 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#112.note: {c1}The University possesses a skeleton of the Adasaur, allowing us some idea of their scale. We also possess drawings of them from before their extinction.{/}

The Royal University's Library#113.src: If you wish to see these drawings, please visit my office in the Blossom wing; I would be happy to show you them.
The Royal University's Library#113.dst: {c1}이 그림들을 보고 싶다면 꽃 학부 건물에 있는 제 연구실로 찾아오십시오. 기꺼이 보여 드리겠습니다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#113.note: {c1}If you wish to see these drawings, please visit my office in the Blossom wing; I would be happy to show you them.{/}

The Royal University's Library#114.src: Liffs (Folium Armis) are a small beetle, entirely exclusive to the {p}. They owe this exclusivity to a symbiotic relationship they have developed with the region's Maple trees.
The Royal University's Library#114.dst: {c1}Liff(Folium Armis)는 {p}에만 서식하는 작은 딱정벌레다. 이처럼 한 곳에만 사는 것은 이 지역의 단풍나무와 맺은 공생 관계 덕분이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#114.note: {c1}Liffs (Folium Armis) are a small beetle, entirely exclusive to the {p}. They owe this exclusivity to a symbiotic relationship they have developed with the region's Maple trees.{/}

The Royal University's Library#115.src: The trees grow large, blue fruits, known as Liffberries, which hang weakly from vines. When the fruits become too heavy, they fall from the vines to be eaten by creatures, particularly Liffs, which then excrete the seeds elsewhere.
The Royal University's Library#115.dst: {c1}이 나무에는 Liff 베리라는 크고 파란 열매가 덩굴에 힘없이 매달려 자란다. 열매가 너무 무거워지면 덩굴에서 떨어져 생물들, 특히 Liff에게 먹히고, Liff는 씨앗을 다른 곳에 배설한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#115.note: {c1}The trees grow large, blue fruits, known as Liffberries, which hang weakly from vines. When the fruits become too heavy, they fall from the vines to be eaten by creatures, particularly Liffs, which then excrete the seeds elsewhere.{/}

The Royal University's Library#116.src: Liffberries are rich in copper, hence their blue colour, meaning few creatures other than Liffs can eat them due to copper's toxicity.
The Royal University's Library#116.dst: {c1}Liff 베리는 구리가 풍부해 파란색을 띠며, 구리의 독성 때문에 Liff 말고는 이를 먹을 수 있는 생물이 거의 없다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#116.note: {c1}Liffberries are rich in copper, hence their blue colour, meaning few creatures other than Liffs can eat them due to copper's toxicity.{/}

The Royal University's Library#117.src: Liffs collect this copper during digestion, using it to create a substance called Copperwax using a specialized gland in their mouths.
The Royal University's Library#117.dst: {c1}Liff는 소화 과정에서 이 구리를 모아, 입 안의 특수한 분비샘으로 구리 밀랍이라는 물질을 만든다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#117.note: {c1}Liffs collect this copper during digestion, using it to create a substance called Copperwax using a specialized gland in their mouths.{/}

The Royal University's Library#118.src: The Liffs then collect leaves from the Maple trees, and coat them in Copperwax, which hardens into high-purity copper, greatly strengthening the leaf affected.
The Royal University's Library#118.dst: {c1}그런 다음 Liff는 단풍나무에서 잎을 모아 구리 밀랍을 바르는데, 이것이 고순도 구리로 굳어 잎을 크게 강화한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#118.note: {c1}The Liffs then collect leaves from the Maple trees, and coat them in Copperwax, which hardens into high-purity copper, greatly strengthening the leaf affected.{/}

The Royal University's Library#119.src: The copper is not oxidized, in fact somewhat resistant to oxidization, meaning the leaf keeps its orange colour in the process.
The Royal University's Library#119.dst: {c1}이 구리는 산화되지 않고 오히려 산화에 다소 강하기 때문에, 이 과정에서도 잎은 주황색을 유지한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#119.note: {c1}The copper is not oxidized, in fact somewhat resistant to oxidization, meaning the leaf keeps its orange colour in the process.{/}

The Royal University's Library#120.src: These hardened leaves, called Liff Leaves, are then worn on the back of the Liff as armor and camoflauge. Eventually, they become oxidized and need replacement.
The Royal University's Library#120.dst: {c1}Liff 잎이라 불리는 이 단단해진 잎은 Liff의 등에 갑옷이자 위장으로 쓰인다. 결국 산화되면 교체해야 한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#120.note: {c1}These hardened leaves, called Liff Leaves, are then worn on the back of the Liff as armor and camoflauge. Eventually, they become oxidized and need replacement.{/}

The Royal University's Library#121.src: Thanks to their metallic quality, Liff Leaves are highly valued by humans and frequently sought, in part because they bear a high value in the {p}'s barter-based economy.
The Royal University's Library#121.dst: {c1}금속성 덕분에 Liff 잎은 인간에게 높이 평가되며 자주 찾는 물건인데, 이는 {p}의 물물교환 경제에서 높은 가치를 지니기 때문이기도 하다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#121.note: {c1}Thanks to their metallic quality, Liff Leaves are highly valued by humans and frequently sought, in part because they bear a high value in the {p}'s barter-based economy.{/}

The Royal University's Library#122.src: Hunting Liffs is hard, however, as they camoflauge very effectively and hide among dense piles of leaves created by Bark Scuttlers, so many in the region have taken to hunting Liffs professionally.
The Royal University's Library#122.dst: {c1}하지만 Liff 사냥은 어렵다. 위장에 아주 능하고, 나무껍질 벌레가 만든 빽빽한 낙엽 더미 속에 숨기 때문이다. 그래서 이 지역의 많은 이들이 Liff 사냥을 생업으로 삼고 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#122.note: {c1}Hunting Liffs is hard, however, as they camoflauge very effectively and hide among dense piles of leaves created by Bark Scuttlers, so many in the region have taken to hunting Liffs professionally.{/}

The Royal University's Library#123.src: The Kingdom of Animalia and Plantae, outside of aberrations of Magicks, do not often find themselves mixing, which makes species like the Snapdragon and Lichendragon particularly intriguing.
The Royal University's Library#123.dst: {c1}동물계와 식물계는 마법의 이상 현상을 제외하면 서로 섞이는 일이 드물기에, 금어초와 지의룡 같은 종은 특히 흥미롭다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#123.note: {c1}The Kingdom of Animalia and Plantae, outside of aberrations of Magicks, do not often find themselves mixing, which makes species like the Snapdragon and Lichendragon particularly intriguing.{/}

The Royal University's Library#124.src: Dissecting a deceased specimen of either species revealed their viscera to be flora, despite functional similarities to animal organs.
The Royal University's Library#124.dst: {c1}두 종 중 어느 쪽이든 죽은 표본을 해부해 보니, 내장이 동물의 장기와 기능이 비슷함에도 식물로 이루어져 있음이 밝혀졌다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#124.note: {c1}Dissecting a deceased specimen of either species revealed their viscera to be flora, despite functional similarities to animal organs.{/}

The Royal University's Library#125.src: Individuals of these species are photoautotrophs, obtaining required nutrients through photosynthesis, and thus their aggression is purely territorial.
The Royal University's Library#125.dst: {c1}이 종들의 개체는 광독립영양생물로, 광합성으로 필요한 영양분을 얻는다. 따라서 이들의 공격성은 순전히 영역 방어에서 비롯된다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#125.note: {c1}Individuals of these species are photoautotrophs, obtaining required nutrients through photosynthesis, and thus their aggression is purely territorial.{/}

The Royal University's Library#126.src: Perhaps even more curious than their bizarre anatomy is their physical similarities to the Dragons of myth, from which their names originate.
The Royal University's Library#126.dst: {c1}기이한 해부학적 구조보다 더 흥미로운 것은 아마 신화 속 용과의 외형적 유사성일 것이며, 이들의 이름도 거기서 유래했다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#126.note: {c1}Perhaps even more curious than their bizarre anatomy is their physical similarities to the Dragons of myth, from which their names originate.{/}

The Royal University's Library#127.src: It is likely these dated fables were inspired by these unique creatures, inspiring the fallacy of massive, flying reptilians.
The Royal University's Library#127.dst: {c1}이 낡은 우화들은 아마 이 독특한 생물에서 영감을 얻었을 것이며, 거대하고 하늘을 나는 파충류라는 오류를 낳았을 것이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#127.note: {c1}It is likely these dated fables were inspired by these unique creatures, inspiring the fallacy of massive, flying reptilians.{/}

The Royal University's Library#128.src: The Industrial Age has brought with it some interesting consequences for the {p}. One such consequence is the rapid proliferation of Slag Beetles.
The Royal University's Library#128.dst: {c1}산업 시대는 {p}에 몇 가지 흥미로운 결과를 가져왔다. 그중 하나가 광재 딱정벌레의 급격한 증식이다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#128.note: {c1}The Industrial Age has brought with it some interesting consequences for the {p}. One such consequence is the rapid proliferation of Slag Beetles.{/}

The Royal University's Library#129.src: Slag Beetles are actually a relative of Liffs, similarly making use of metals to develop protective coating. However, unlike the Liff, which only gathers metal from Liffberries, the Slag Beetle eats raw metal.
The Royal University's Library#129.dst: {c1}광재 딱정벌레는 사실 Liff의 친척으로, 마찬가지로 금속을 이용해 보호막을 만든다. 하지만 Liff 베리에서만 금속을 얻는 Liff와 달리, 광재 딱정벌레는 날 금속을 먹는다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#129.note: {c1}Slag Beetles are actually a relative of Liffs, similarly making use of metals to develop protective coating. However, unlike the Liff, which only gathers metal from Liffberries, the Slag Beetle eats raw metal.{/}

The Royal University's Library#130.src: In nature, the Slag Beetle fed only on ores it could scrounge up, and was usually found around the Penitence District's mines. When the Industrial Age began, though, they quickly found new sources of material.
The Royal University's Library#130.dst: {c1}자연 상태에서 광재 딱정벌레는 겨우 찾아낸 광석만 먹었고, 주로 Penitence District의 광산 주변에서 발견되었다. 하지만 산업 시대가 시작되자 이들은 금세 새로운 먹이원을 찾아냈다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#130.note: {c1}In nature, the Slag Beetle fed only on ores it could scrounge up, and was usually found around the Penitence District's mines. When the Industrial Age began, though, they quickly found new sources of material.{/}

The Royal University's Library#131.src: Now, these beetles are a common pest in the {p}, often eating through metal infrastructure and, frequently, leading to the closure of factories.
The Royal University's Library#131.dst: {c1}이제 이 딱정벌레는 {p}의 흔한 해충으로, 금속 기반 시설을 갉아 먹어 공장이 문을 닫는 일도 잦다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#131.note: {c1}Now, these beetles are a common pest in the {p}, often eating through metal infrastructure and, frequently, leading to the closure of factories.{/}

The Royal University's Library#132.src: This has been majorly problematic, especially for large-scale projects like the Great Sap Siphon, and all known preventative measures are either costly or complicated.
The Royal University's Library#132.dst: {c1}이는 특히 거대한 수액 흡입탑 같은 대규모 사업에 큰 골칫거리였으며, 알려진 예방책은 모두 비용이 많이 들거나 복잡하다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#132.note: {c1}This has been majorly problematic, especially for large-scale projects like the Great Sap Siphon, and all known preventative measures are either costly or complicated.{/}

The Royal University's Library#133.src: Slag Beetles are vulnerable to high temperatures, so some have attempted to create defence systems based on this weakness, yet so far none have worked.
The Royal University's Library#133.dst: {c1}광재 딱정벌레는 고온에 약해 이 약점을 이용한 방어 체계를 만들려는 시도가 있었지만, 아직 성공한 것은 없다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#133.note: {c1}Slag Beetles are vulnerable to high temperatures, so some have attempted to create defence systems based on this weakness, yet so far none have worked.{/}

The Royal University's Library#134.src: For now, numbers are kept down through extermination campaigns run by the Crown, which has done well enough.
The Royal University's Library#134.dst: {c1}현재로서는 왕실이 벌이는 박멸 작전으로 개체 수를 억제하고 있으며, 그럭저럭 효과를 보고 있다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#134.note: {c1}For now, numbers are kept down through extermination campaigns run by the Crown, which has done well enough.{/}

The Royal University's Library#135.src: This hefty volume is titled "On the Affect of Industrialization on Wildlife"
The Royal University's Library#135.dst: 이 두꺼운 책의 제목은 {c2}"산업화가 야생 생물에 미치는 영향에 관하여"{/}다.
The Royal University's Library#135.note: {c2}"On the Affect of Industrialization on Wildlife"{/}

The Royal University's Library#136.src: This book seems excessively wordy and scientific. It looks like a chore to read, but potentially quite interesting. Would you like to read it?
The Royal University's Library#136.dst: 지나치게 장황하고 학술적인 책 같다. 읽기 고역일 것 같지만, 꽤 흥미로울지도 모른다. 읽어 볼까?

The Royal University's Library#137.src: Species Euglenozoa Hedorah, colloquially known as 'Hedoro', are organisms common to the {p} of Fruma that engage in conspecific colony behavior to form unitary creatures.
The Royal University's Library#137.dst: {c1}Species Euglenozoa Hedorah(통칭 'Hedoro')는 Fruma의 {p}에 흔한 생물로, 동종 군체 행동을 통해 단일한 생명체를 이룬다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#137.note: {c1}Species Euglenozoa Hedorah, colloquially known as 'Hedoro', are organisms common to the {p} of Fruma that engage in conspecific colony behavior to form unitary creatures.{/}

The Royal University's Library#138.src: Prior to the wide-scale industrialization of Fruma beneath our glorious Majesty, the Hedoro species were placid, filter feeding organisms composed of identical members (clones) within a microbial colony.
The Royal University's Library#138.dst: {c1}영광스러운 폐하의 치하에서 Fruma가 대규모로 산업화되기 전, Hedoro 종은 미생물 군체 속 동일한 개체(클론)로 이루어진 온순한 여과 섭식 생물이었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#138.note: {c1}Prior to the wide-scale industrialization of Fruma beneath our glorious Majesty, the Hedoro species were placid, filter feeding organisms composed of identical members (clones) within a microbial colony.{/}

The Royal University's Library#139.src: As the population of Fruma increased in number, a demand for food increased tenfold, requiring of the agricultural organizations of the Province to increase their yields, resulting in the advent of "Artifical Plant Nutrient", or "Synthetic Fertilizer".
The Royal University's Library#139.dst: {c1}Fruma의 인구가 늘어나면서 식량 수요가 열 배로 뛰었고, 지방의 농업 조직들은 수확량을 늘려야 했으며, 그 결과 "인공 식물 영양제", 즉 "합성 비료"가 등장했다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#139.note: {c1}As the population of Fruma increased in number, a demand for food increased tenfold, requiring of the agricultural organizations of the Province to increase their yields, resulting in the advent of "Artifical Plant Nutrient", or "Synthetic Fertilizer".{/}

The Royal University's Library#140.src: While the introduction of fertilizer greatly improved the quantity of food, it created a problem only recognizable in hindsight: the green tides.
The Royal University's Library#140.dst: {c1}비료의 도입은 식량의 양을 크게 늘렸지만, 나중에야 알게 된 문제를 낳았다. 바로 녹조다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#140.note: {c1}While the introduction of fertilizer greatly improved the quantity of food, it created a problem only recognizable in hindsight: the green tides.{/}

The Royal University's Library#141.src: Fertilizer proved itself vital to our growing empire, but the enriching qualities it had in our cultivars caused an immense increase in the population of the 'Hedoro' species.
The Royal University's Library#141.dst: {c1}비료는 성장하는 우리 제국에 꼭 필요한 것으로 입증되었으나, 우리 작물을 비옥하게 한 그 성질이 'Hedoro' 종의 개체 수를 엄청나게 늘렸다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#141.note: {c1}Fertilizer proved itself vital to our growing empire, but the enriching qualities it had in our cultivars caused an immense increase in the population of the 'Hedoro' species.{/}

The Royal University's Library#142.src: Provided with nutrients, 'Hedoro' colonies were able to multiply enough to produce harmful algal blooms.
The Royal University's Library#142.dst: {c1}영양분을 공급받은 'Hedoro' 군체는 유해한 조류 대발생을 일으킬 만큼 번식할 수 있었다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#142.note: {c1}Provided with nutrients, 'Hedoro' colonies were able to multiply enough to produce harmful algal blooms.{/}

The Royal University's Library#143.src: This resulted in a decrease in the biodiversity of the {p}'s aquatic flora and fauna, as freshwater invertebrates were starved of oxygen.
The Royal University's Library#143.dst: {c1}그 결과 담수 무척추동물이 산소 부족에 시달리며, {p}의 수생 동식물의 생물 다양성이 감소했다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#143.note: {c1}This resulted in a decrease in the biodiversity of the {p}'s aquatic flora and fauna, as freshwater invertebrates were starved of oxygen.{/}

The Royal University's Library#144.src: In present day, 'Hedoro' have become nuisance wildlife, frequently causing blockages in piping due to their unchecked growth and, rarely, attacks on humans.
The Royal University's Library#144.dst: {c1}오늘날 'Hedoro'는 골칫거리 야생 생물이 되어, 걷잡을 수 없는 증식으로 배관을 자주 막고, 드물게는 인간을 공격하기도 한다.{/}
The Royal University's Library#144.note: {c1}In present day, 'Hedoro' have become nuisance wildlife, frequently causing blockages in piping due to their unchecked growth and, rarely, attacks on humans.{/}
